title: Thomas Edison: Inventor and Busy Team Leader (2/2)
titleZh: 愛迪生：發明家與忙碌的團隊領導者 (2/2)
summaryZh: 介紹愛迪生的工作習慣、他認為最難的發明電燈，以及他留下的影響。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — As It Is

sentences.text: He usually worked eighteen hours each day because he enjoyed what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 他通常每天工作十八個小時，因為他很享受自己在做的事。

sentences.text: A reporter asked Edison in 1917 which of his many inventions he enjoyed the most.
sentences.zh: 1917 年，一位記者問愛迪生，在他眾多發明中最喜歡哪一項。

sentences.text: The hardest invention to develop, he said, was the electric light.
sentences.zh: 他說，最難研發出來的發明是電燈。

sentences.text: He said that it was the most difficult and the most important.
sentences.zh: 他說那是最困難、也是最重要的一項。

sentences.text: He also invented the modern motion picture film.
sentences.zh: 他也發明了現代的電影底片。

sentences.text: In 1928, he received a special medal of honor from the Congress of the United States.
sentences.zh: 1928 年，他獲頒美國國會的特別榮譽獎章。

sentences.text: Thomas Edison died on January 6, 1931. People worldwide have had easier and more enjoyable lives because of his inventions.
sentences.zh: 愛迪生於 1931 年 1 月 6 日過世。因為他的發明，全世界的人生活得更方便、也更享受。
